recommendations.title: Pre-specify a nonzero Monte Carlo tolerance only when justified
recommendations.problem: The realized-FDR gate accepts a configurable Monte Carlo tolerance, but the workflow does not yet define when a nonzero value is scientifically justified.
recommendations.root_cause: The corrective gate added a flexible tolerance parameter without coupling it to a pre-specified simulation-error rule or minimum nsims.
recommendations.fix: Keep the default tolerance at zero. If a study uses a nonzero tolerance, state it before simulation and increase nsims until the accept/reject decision is stable.
